summary: Iteration 4 Planetary Defense backend fully tested. 23/23 pytest tests pass. All 10 new endpoints verified plus edge cases (invalid layer, no-matching-wave, duplicate node build, insufficient resources, legacy player auto-bootstrap, apollyon_victory via viability<=25).
test_scenarios_verified: defense/config returns 5 layers in penetration order with max_hp 500/400/300/250/200
defense/config returns 7 zones with weights summing to 100, 8 network nodes
New player defense state: viability=100, sensor_tier=1, network_progress=[], protocols=[], layers full-HP, zones=100%
State 404 for unknown player_id
Legacy player doc without `defense` auto-bootstraps on /player/{id} and /defense/state/{id}
Assign robot to orbital + ground; reassignment removes robot from previous layer
Assign to layer_id='resource_zones' -> 400 Invalid layer
Assign to bogus layer 'moon_base' -> 400
Unassign works and is idempotent
Repair fully-healed layer returns repaired=0
Repair with layer_id='resource_zones' -> 400
Protocol save round-trip; server assigns rule id when missing; persists across state fetch
Tier-1 scan: intel.level=1, breakdown=None, unknown_signatures populated, decoys shown as type_display='unknown'
Engage without matching wave -> 400 'No matching wave. Scan first.'
Full scan->engage flow: response includes wave_id, outcome, log, viability_after, layers_after, zones_after, adaptations, rewards, resources
Same wave_id cannot be engaged twice (last_wave cleared after engage)
Network build deep_space_array: sensor_tier upgrades 1->2, deep_space.max_hp increases exactly +15%
After sensor upgrade, next scan shows intel.level=2 with breakdown populated
Duplicate node build -> 400 'Node already built'
Insufficient resources -> 400 with detail 'Need N <RESOURCE>'
Unknown node id -> 404
defense/reset restores viability=100, sensor_tier=1, network_progress=[], layers full HP, zones=100%
Repeated undefended waves eventually reach viability<=25 -> outcome='apollyon_victory'
critical_code_review_comments: Note: /defense/repair fails with 400 when partial-repair funds exist. Repair is all-or-nothing; consider partial-repair for UX (informational only).
Note: /invasion/engage clears defense.last_wave after use, so replaying the same wave_id fails. This is intended per spec; documenting for FE.
Note: Adaptations only trigger when a weapon has been used >=5 times (weapon_usage counter). Requires either battles or repeated engages to observe. Verified indirectly.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_IT4_* players and TEST_LEGACY_* raw docs. Robots prefixed TEST_R{i}. All isolated via unique codenames.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 backend is green. If retesting, run: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration4.py -v. Tests are parallelism-safe (each critical test calls /defense/reset before its assertions). Player fixture is module-scoped and uses _mint_resources() to bypass grind. Frontend was intentionally NOT tested (user will verify via Expo Go).
